events.title: Trivia with Geeks Who Drink
events.summary: Quiz night every Wednesday at 6:30pm. Free to play.
events.description: Geeks Who Drink bring their quiz to the taproom every Wednesday at 6:30pm. Free to play, no sign-up needed — just turn up with a team.

events.title: Bike Night
events.summary: Show off your bike, pedal or powered, in our parking lot.
events.description: Bring your bike — pedal or powered — and show it off in our parking lot. Parking with us for Street Faire? Even better. Beer, pizza from Double D's, and a lot full of bikes.

events.title: Re-Launch Party
events.summary: Rotating beer discounts, special tappings, and a chance to say hi to the new owners.
events.description:
Louisville's oldest brewery has new owners. Matt Gorbsky and Don Brown took over on July 1st, and we're throwing a party to mark it. Rotating beer discounts through the afternoon, special tappings, and a chance to say hello.

Our big anniversary party, with live music, follows on September 12th.

events.title: Battles & Brews
events.summary: Tabletop D&D with professional Game Masters. Free to play.
events.description:
Tabletop D&D night run by professional Game Masters. Free to play and all experience levels welcome — you don't need to bring anything but yourself.

July sold out, so register early.

events.title: Anniversary Party
events.summary: Our anniversary party, with live music.
events.description: Our big anniversary party, with live music — carrying on a Gravity tradition. More details closer to the day.
